run_token_length_normalized: run token length normalized sampling to select the choice with the highest normalized prompt logprob
run_greedy_token_selection: run greedy token selection to pick the best choice by comparing per-token logprobs across options
run_unconditional_likelihood_normalized: run unconditional likelihood normalization to select the best choice adjusted by unconditional token logprobs
build_choices_decision: build a ChoicesDecision dataclass instance with a selected choice string and optional metadata dictionary
test_choices_sampling_method: test the abstract ChoicesSamplingMethod base class interface for callable selection methods
